label: EXPLORATORY_PILOT
research_question: Under the corrected QLIKE sign convention, does ANY funding-conditioned model (B/C/D/E) beat RV-only (A) across multiple chronological holdouts on the cached 2024-04..09 panel, and is any observed effect distinguishable from a placebo permutation null of the funding series?

prior_state.robust_04_finding: On the 2024-09 holdout the funding-trail model E was WORSE than RV-only: A - E = -0.029418, bootstrap CI95 [-0.042126, -0.015872]. Materiality floor not met.
prior_state.sign_convention: delta_qlike_vs_A = mean(QLIKE_A - QLIKE_model); QLIKE is a LOSS so positive = model better. The earlier 'funding-trail improves QLIKE' headline was a sign inversion and must not be repeated.

design.type: four chronological holdouts with expanding train and 7-day purge/embargo
design.entry_origin_rule: origin at close of 1h bar t; features use only data available no later than bar t close (causal); trailing RV windows end at bar t; funding = latest observation with calc_time <= bar t close; a 24h-ahead target requires bars t+1..t+24 fully inside the declared window
design.target: next-24h realized variance from 1h mark-price close-to-close log returns t+1..t+24 (sum of 24 hourly squared log returns, dimensionless)

features.standardization: train-only mean/std; zero-variance columns set std=1

model_family.type: stdlib OLS on log realized variance (HAR-style), normal equations + Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting; Duan smearing back-transformation on train residuals

evaluation.contrast: paired per-origin Delta QLIKE vs A_rv_only = QLIKE_A - QLIKE_model (positive = model better)
evaluation.uncertainty: UTC-day block bootstrap, resampled jointly across instruments, seed 12345, 2000 reps, percentile CI95
evaluation.robustness: leave-one-instrument-out (LOIO) mean Delta QLIKE vs A per holdout

placebo.description: Deterministic permutation of the funding observation series (same observed rate values, perturbed time order) fed through the identical feature/estimation/evaluation pipeline, seed 12345. Reported as the placebo Delta QLIKE distribution for E.
placebo.purpose: If the real funding-trail Delta QLIKE cannot beat the placebo magnitude, any apparent effect is indistinguishable from a null reordering of funding information.

materiality_floor: E beats A (mean(QLIKE_A - QLIKE_E) > 0 with bootstrap CI95 lower bound > 0) in >= 3 of 4 holdouts AND real funding-trail |mean Delta QLIKE| exceeds placebo |mean Delta QLIKE|. Otherwise report an honest negative result.
prohibitions: no repeated sign-inverted 'funding-trail improves QLIKE' claim
sealed_months: none touched; 2024-04..2024-09 is the provenanced exploratory cache, not sealed confirmatory data
honest_status: EXPLORATORY/PILOT. Multi-holdout robustness + placebo null for an exploratory Track C result; negative results are a valid completion; no confirmatory promotion claimed.
